holds.raw: נכדו של רב ירמיה בר אבא
holds.reason: The parallel Heilprin notice gives the same relation. In Yuhasin the main Rami bar Mari notice offers a tentative interpretation involving Mari and the bracketed reading gives grandson. Berakhot has a Mari descended from R. Yirmeyah bar Abba through Rav Huna, but it does not name Rami bar Mari.

evidence.reference: Sefer Yuhasin, Treatise II, London 1857, p. 188, Rami bar Mari
evidence.witness: Sefer Yuhasin, Treatise II, London 1857, p. 188, Rami bar Mari

notes.text: The kinship is asserted in both Heilprin entries. The printed Yuhasin has a qualified interpretation with a variant, and the distinct Mari of Berakhot does not secure the identification.
